segments.basis: KG-4 (kg4_compute seg_bounds, minutes ET 570/630/900/960; joints priced at open of 09:30 bar, close of 10:29 bar, close of 14:59 bar, close of 15:59 bar; session complete at >=380 RTH bars)

sleeves.object: LS9 Short the midday segment, only after an up drive
sleeves.falsifier: Re-grade the conditioned split at 40 sessions on the cluster basis (the registered check): the sleeve dies if the conditioned short-midday cluster mean is not positive net of 5bp, or if the down-drive control separates equally (which would kill the conditioner claim even if the segment paid). Historical basis: unconditioned short-midday cluster t 1.53; conditioned on an up drive, pooled +34.79bp (t 2.74, 149 symbol-sessions) and session-cluster +55.62bp (t 2.01, 13 sessions); after a down drive the cluster read fades (t 0.81). Thirteen sessions is the named limit.
sleeves.kill_rule: Conditioned cluster mean not positive net of 5bp at 40 sessions, or the down-drive control separating equally, retires the sleeve specification.
sleeves.expression: On a Focus name whose morning segment prints an up drive (as defined in LEAD-STACKING's session split), short the name for the midday segment only, flat before the close segment; after a down drive, no trade (the control arm is logged in shadow on the 1Min cache).
sleeves.sizing: One standard desk sleeve slice, equal weight across the session's qualifying names, paper only; intraday only, no overnight carry, so no borrow beyond the intraday short, priced from the daily IB snapshot archive on the Focus names.
sleeves.status: LIVE 2026-11-16 (SEGMENT-CONSTRUCTION-20261116); paper only, one standard $10,000 slice, equal weight across the session's qualifying (up-drive) names, intraday only, flat before the close segment

sleeves.falsifier: Forward panel re-run at 20 study nights (early December 2026, the registered check): if the forward midday segment mean, net of a 6bp round-trip cost standard, is at or above 0, or the segment-forced placebo sleeves (A6 archetypes, the registered null) match its magnitude, the variation retires.
sleeves.kill_rule: Forward midday mean net of 6bp at or above 0 at 20 nights, or placebo parity, retires b3_midday_fade_var. The parent shape claim returns to WATCH; nothing else is touched.
sleeves.expression: Short the Focus 29 basket equal weight at the end of the open-drive segment and cover at the start of the close hour, paper, shadow, on sessions where the full basket is present. Segment boundaries are the Lane 3 / KG-4 phase decomposition's own segment definitions, copied at wiring time from KG-4-PHASE-DECOMPOSITION.md, not re-derived.
sleeves.sizing: One standard desk sleeve slice, equal weight across names present, paper only, no leverage.
sleeves.status: LIVE 2026-11-16 (SEGMENT-CONSTRUCTION-20261116); paper only, one standard $10,000 slice, equal weight across the full Focus 29 basket when present, intraday only
